display.purpose: Hero headline and the 404 title in Playfair Display 500; clamp(2.75rem, 12vw, 4rem) on phones.

headline.purpose: Section titles in Playfair Display 500 (Popular Picks, Our Menu, Find Us); clamp(2rem, 8vw, 3rem) on phones.

headline-sm.purpose: Titles on contained surfaces in Playfair Display 600; the Follow card title.

title.purpose: Dish names on menu cards in Playfair Display 600 (1.0625rem on the phone rows).

script.purpose: Caveat Brush handwritten aside: the About and Follow lines (the reel's own), the category blurb and the 404 code. Not a pattern for new section eyebrows.

body-md.purpose: Menu intro, Visit text and quick-view description in smoke grey.

body-sm.purpose: Hero and About copy, footer links, opening-hours rows, the Follow card phone number.

caption.purpose: Dish descriptions on cards and rows, the allergen line, open or closed status and the footer blurb.

label.purpose: Buttons and menu tabs: Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 0.9375rem (tabs 0.875rem on phones).

label-caps.purpose: Tag chips: uppercase 700 with 0.08em tracking; the dish badge is floored at 11px.

wordmark.purpose: The PICCOLO logotype, Plus Jakarta Sans 800 uppercase.

shadows.name: sh-cta
shadows.purpose: Orange floor glow under orange-filled pills (primary button, selected tab, quick-view and phone-menu call pills, About play button). The Follow call pill takes a cream halo and the dock Call none.

shadows.name: sh-cta-hover
shadows.purpose: Deeper glow while the primary button is lifted on hover (fine pointers).

shadows.name: sh-card
shadows.purpose: Resting plate shadow: menu cards and rows, tab track, Visit card, map tile.

shadows.name: sh-dark
shadows.purpose: Tall plum shadow under large slabs: the Follow card and the quick-view panel.

shadows.name: sh-bar
shadows.purpose: The frosted navbar when it returns on scroll up, and the hero scroll knob.

shadows.name: sh-dock
shadows.purpose: The Action Dock, cast upward from its top edge: the one shadow in the system that falls up.

shadows.name: fx-item
shadows.purpose: drop-shadow filter for cut-out dish art on cards, rows, the quick view and the 404 page.

shadows.name: fx-cluster
shadows.purpose: drop-shadow filter for the About food cluster.

shadows.name: fx-slab-item
shadows.purpose: drop-shadow filter for food resting on the hero slab.

shadows.name: fx-prop
shadows.purpose: drop-shadow filter for the hero golden cutter.

shadows.name: fx-on-dark
shadows.purpose: drop-shadow filter for the art on the Follow card.

shadows.name: fx-knob
shadows.purpose: drop-shadow filter under the hero headline badge.

shadows.name: ring-line
shadows.purpose: 1px hairline ring on ghost buttons, dock actions, the card details button and the quick-view close button.

shadows.name: ring-on-dark
shadows.purpose: 1px ring around round buttons over the aubergine phone menu.

shadows.name: halo-cream
shadows.purpose: Soft cream ring around the Follow card call pill.

shadows.name: halo-ok
shadows.purpose: Ring around the open-now status dot (navbar, Visit card, dock).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Quint-out (GSAP power4.out). Default for hovers, lifts, the navbar, the hero intro, tab pill and island motion.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Expo-out (GSAP expo.out). The Follow card morph, the hero slab and title lines, the dock arrival, the call ping and the quick-view dish.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Quart-out (GSAP power3.out). Scroll reveals, fitted to the reel.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: Presence fade fallback and the skip link.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Colour, shadow and transform transitions on hover and press.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Lifts, underline sweeps, art tilt and the navbar slide.

motion.name: dur-4
motion.purpose: Map tile zoom.

motion.name: press
motion.value: scale(0.97) while held, every a and button
motion.purpose: Global press feedback (base.css). A whole dish card or row does not scale: it takes the --c-press tint instead.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Headings, panels and copy fading up once when their section reaches the trigger line (copy rises 1.75rem, staggered 0.2s).

motion.name: card-reveal
motion.purpose: Popular dish cards.

motion.name: cluster-reveal
motion.value: 1.1s power4.out, travel 6.5rem from the bottom-left, scale 0.96 to 1
motion.purpose: The About food cluster.

motion.name: scene-triggers
motion.value: about top 72%, popular top 85%, menu top 78%, visit top 78%, follow top 70%
motion.purpose: ScrollTrigger start lines; every scene plays once, in time, never scrubbed.

motion.name: hero-lines
motion.value: 0.5s expo-out, rise 1rem; line one at 0.3s, line two at 0.42s
motion.purpose: The two hero title lines rising one after the other (CSS keyframes).

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.value: 0.6s ease-out; transform-origin right at rest, left when active or hovered
motion.purpose: The orange underline grows from the left and runs out to the right, so it is handed from link to link.

motion.name: dock-in
motion.value: 0.5s expo-out after 0.8s, from translate 100% and opacity 0
motion.purpose: The Action Dock sliding up from the screen edge (CSS keyframes, opacity and transform only).

motion.name: follow-width
motion.purpose: The Follow card widening from a thin stadium (signature motion).

motion.name: follow-radius
motion.purpose: The Follow card corners staying a stadium, then relaxing.

motion.name: follow-layers
motion.value: slide from the card centre over 0.96s expo.out; fades art 0.18s, text 0.3s from 0.1s, sparkle 0.25s from 0.15s
motion.purpose: Art and text spreading out un-clipped while the card grows (phones: rise 1.5rem instead).

motion.name: follow-ping
motion.value: 0.9s expo-out after 1.05s, ring scale 1 to 1.3, opacity 0.7 to 0
motion.purpose: One ring leaving the Call-now pill once the card is open (CSS keyframes).

motion.name: tab-pill
motion.purpose: The orange pill sliding between menu tabs; new cards rise 28px over 0.5s with a 0.06s stagger.

motion.name: phone-menu
motion.value: circle 0.65s power4.out; links 0.55s from 0.28s, stagger 0.07s; footer 0.5s from 0.6s
motion.purpose: The phone menu opening as a clip-path circle from the toggle.

motion.name: quick-view
motion.purpose: Quick-view dialog enter; exit rises 24px to scale 0.98.

motion.name: quick-view-dish
motion.value: dish steps from the tapped card picture to its place: 0.55s expo.out in, 0.4s back out
motion.purpose: The dish leaves the card it was tapped on (x, y and scale only) and returns to it on close.

motion.name: lite-tier
motion.purpose: TV and low-end devices: shorter, faster motion. The static tier (reduced motion) animates nothing.

motion.name: hero-ring
motion.purpose: The rotating text ring around the hero scroll knob; the only linear motion in the system.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
Piccolo is a clean, well-lit counter in a small place that cooks to order. The page is a warm white (#fdfafb) lit from above: plates sit on it and drop long, soft shadows straight down, and food is always a transparent cut-out, so a dish looks set on the surface instead of pasted into a box. Orange is the single source of heat: it fills the one thing to press on each surface, carries an aubergine label, and turns to a burnt-crust brown wherever it has to be read as text. Dark surfaces are rare and always slabs: the charcoal serving slab in the hero art, the aubergine Follow card and the aubergine phone menu.

The voice is editorial-casual rather than fast-food loud. High-contrast Playfair Display carries headlines and dish names, a round geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) carries everything you read quickly or act on, and a brush script (Caveat Brush) is a rare handwritten aside. Density is low: section padding runs 3rem to 8rem and most sections hold one heading, one block of copy and one action or one grid. The layout copies a reference reel measured on a 1440px artboard, and it is phone first: below 1024px a fixed Action Dock keeps the open status, Call, WhatsApp and Directions under the thumb, dishes are compact rows, targets are 44px and everything tappable sinks while it is held.

Motion is quiet and out-curved. Every ease decelerates (quint, expo and quart out); hovers and lifts take 0.35s to 0.6s and are for fine pointers; each section reveals once, in time, as it reaches the viewport (about 0.7s, rising 1.75rem to 2rem). One moment is choreographed: the Follow card widens from a thin stadium to a full plate while its corners relax. That expansion is a binding brand commitment (PRODUCT.md), so other effects must not compete with it; the few small authored effects around it are short and serve the action (the nav underline handed from link to link, the two hero lines rising one after the other, the dock sliding up, a ring leaving the Call-now pill, the quick view's dish stepping out of the card that was tapped). The orange-on-warm-white palette, the three typefaces and the layout inside each section are the incumbent system recorded here, not commitments. Imagery is generated SVG illustration by decision; there is no stock photography.
keyCharacteristics: Warm white page and near-white plates (#fdfafb, #fefefe) separated by shadow, not by tone.
Orange is the only saturated colour: a vertical gradient pill with an orange floor glow for the action and an aubergine label on it, burnt orange (#b8420a) wherever orange is text.
Neutrals tinted toward plum, and one dark aubergine slate (#271b25).
Playfair Display 500 and 600 for headlines, Plus Jakarta Sans for UI and body, Caveat Brush for asides.
Stadiums for what you press, 1.125rem and 2rem plates for what holds content.
Soft, tinted shadows with negative spread; 1px hairline rings instead of borders.
Transparent cut-out food art grounded by drop-shadow filters.
Phone first: a fixed Action Dock, compact dish rows, 44px targets and a press state on everything tappable.
All lengths in rem; above 1024px the root scales with the viewport (1rem = 1/16 of a 1440px artboard).
One signature motion (the Follow card) and ease-out everywhere else.

rules.name: The One Heat Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only saturated UI colour. It fills one action per surface, marks hover and selection, and in its darker text form carries prices, active links and small icons. Gold, red and green are single-use spot colours, never a second accent.

rules.name: The Burnt Crust Rule
rules.body: Orange text on a light surface is always `--c-accent-text`. The bright `--c-accent` is for fills, underlines, rings and text on aubergine (5.6:1).

rules.name: The Dark Label Rule
rules.body: Every label or glyph on an orange fill is aubergine (`--c-on-accent`, #271b25): 6.5:1 on #ff7d31 and 4.95:1 on #ed600f. White (`--c-on-dark`) belongs on ink and aubergine surfaces, never on orange.

rules.name: The Plum Tint Rule
rules.body: The greys lean toward plum (OKLCH hue 299 to 355 degrees) rather than neutral grey, and the dark slate is the same plum at low lightness (hue 332). Pure black appears only inside two drop-shadow filters.

rules.name: The Serif Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair names things (headings, dish names, the phone menu's links); Plus Jakarta Sans does things (buttons, tabs, prices, hours, body copy); Caveat Brush only comments.

rules.name: The Weight Step Rule
rules.body: Playfair is 500 at page and section level and 600 inside a contained surface (menu card, quick view, the dark Follow card); the extra weight keeps it crisp at small sizes and on aubergine. Headings balance their lines and paragraphs use `text-wrap: pretty` where the browser supports it.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Prices, opening-hours times and quick-view sizes are set in tabular numerals (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) so stacked figures line up.

rules.name: The Artboard Rule
rules.body: Write rem, never px. Above 1024px a length measured on the 1440px artboard is the same number in rem.

rules.name: The Peek Rule
rules.body: A phone scroller shows the edge of its next item so it reads as scrollable: Popular cards are 78% wide, so the next card peeks.

rules.name: The Floor Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is the shade under an object: it falls straight down, has a negative spread, and takes the colour of what casts it (plum for plates, orange for orange pills). The dock, which sits on the screen edge, is the one that falls up.

rules.name: The Quiet Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Plates rest flat and lift only on hover (fine pointers) or deepen on focus-within: a card rises 0.375rem and its shadow grows. The lift never changes the plate's colour. On touch there is no lift: a held tappable sinks to 0.97 and a whole card or row takes the `--c-press` tint instead.

rules.name: The Stadium and Plate Rule
rules.body: What you press is a stadium or a circle; what holds content is a plate with 1.125rem or 2rem corners. Nothing in the system has a sharp corner.

rules.name: The One Signature Rule
rules.body: The Follow card's expansion is the only choreographed spectacle. Every other motion is a short ease-out that serves content (the call ping is its coda), and nothing may compete with it.

dos: Do take every colour, radius, shadow, duration and easing from `src/styles/tokens.css`, and add the token first when a value is missing (stylelint rejects hex and colour functions anywhere else).
Do write lengths in rem: 1rem is 1/16 of the 1440px artboard above 1024px, so artboard measurements convert one to one.
Do set orange text on light surfaces in `--c-accent-text` (#b8420a) and keep `--c-accent` (#fb6917) for fills, underlines, rings and text on aubergine.
Do set the label and glyph on every orange fill in `--c-on-accent` (aubergine #271b25): 6.5:1 on #ff7d31, 4.95:1 on #ed600f. Keep white (`--c-on-dark`) for ink and aubergine surfaces.

Do give each surface one orange-filled action (vertical gradient from #ff7d31 to #ed600f with `--sh-cta`); make secondary actions ghost pills (Plate White fill, 1px `--c-line` ring) or quiet smoke-grey links.
Do make what you press a stadium (62.5rem) or a circle, and give content plates 1.125rem corners (cards) or 2rem corners (quick view, Follow card, Visit card, map tile).
Do set Playfair Display at weight 500 for page and section headings and 600 inside plates (cards, dialog, Follow card); use Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else.
Do ground food art with a `--fx-*` drop-shadow filter and plates with an `--sh-*` shadow, tinted plum or orange.

Do keep every ease an out-curve (`--ease-out`, `--ease-expo`, `--ease-soft`), gate hover lifts behind `@media (hover: hover)` and answer a press with `scale(0.97)`; a whole card or row takes the `--c-press` tint instead.
Do keep the focus ring: a 0.1875rem solid outline in `--c-focus` (ink), 0.25rem out, white on aubergine, 0.3125rem on TV; it is never removed.

Do keep tap targets at 2.75rem (44px) on phones for buttons, tabs, nav, footer links and social buttons and dock actions, and make a whole card or row the hit area (an overlay on its details button) instead of a small arrow.
Do set prices, opening hours and sizes in tabular numerals.
Do floor small labels: the dish badge is max(0.6875rem, 11px), so it never drops below 11px when the root shrinks.
Do reserve `--dock-h` at the bottom of pages below 1024px (the footer's padding) so the Action Dock never covers content.
donts: Don't write a hex or colour function outside `tokens.css`, and don't use `@layer`, `@container`, `@scope`, `:has()`, `:is()`, dvh, svh or lvh units, `color-mix()`, `light-dark()`, individual transform properties (`translate`, `scale`, `rotate`) or native nesting: the floor is Chromium 94, Safari 15 and Firefox 100. The one sanctioned exception is a newer value refining an older declaration written right above it, with an inline stylelint disable and a reason (the hero's `100vh` then `100svh`).
Don't set text on a light surface in `--c-accent` (2.8:1 on the page).
Don't set white text or glyphs on the orange gradient or the flat orange (2.6:1 to 3.3:1): the label on orange is aubergine.

Don't animate anything but `opacity` and `transform`, and never `visibility` or `autoAlpha` in animation code: hidden content cannot take keyboard focus (ADR 0003). The Follow card's width and corner radius are the stated exemption.
Don't add a second choreographed spectacle: the Follow card's expansion is the signature and other effects must not compete with it.
Don't hide content before it is revealed except through the `data-reveal` protocol, which applies only while script runs and motion is allowed; the page must be complete without scripts.
Don't use hard-offset, zero-blur or black shadows on surfaces: every elevation in the system is soft, has a negative spread and falls straight down (the dock's, on the screen edge, falls up).
Don't put a script line above a section heading: the shared heading has none. The About and Follow lines are the reel's own.
Don't transform the card's details button while it is pressed: its overlay is what makes the whole card the hit area, and a transform would shrink it.
Don't introduce a breakpoint other than 640, 768, 1024 and 1440 px (a unit test scans CSS, `sizes`, `matchMedia` and `client:media`).
Don't add stock photography while the generated illustrations stand in as imagery (PRODUCT.md); the incumbent shows food only as transparent cut-outs, never in cropped rectangles.
observations: Text below 11px. The logo tagline is 0.4375rem (7px at a 16px root, 6.1px at the 1253px reference viewport), 0.5rem (8px) below 1024px and 0.625rem on TV: it is the reel's wordmark lockup, kept as drawn. The hero's rotating "Scroll down" ring label is about 7px (decorative, hidden from assistive technology). The quick view's tag chip is plain 0.6875rem, so it falls to 9.6px at 1253px (the dish badge is floored at 11px).

Small running text. The footer copyright and "Back to top" are 0.75rem (12px); dish descriptions, allergen lines, status labels, the footer blurb and hours are 0.8125rem (13px); hero and About paragraphs are 0.875rem (14px). Between 1024px and 1253px the root drops to 13.92px, so all of these shrink by 13% (descriptions render at 11.3px, hero copy at 12.2px), smaller than on a phone.

Repeated placeholder art. Fifteen menu items share four illustrations: all six pizza cards (Margherita, Pepperoni Fire, Quattro Formaggi, BBQ Chicken, Garden Veggie, Prosciutto & Rocket) show the same pizza slice, and the hot dogs, sandwiches and drinks repeat one illustration each. By decision (PRODUCT.md) the illustrations stand in until real art exists.

Script lines that remain. About ("About us") and Follow ("Stay in touch") keep the reel's brush-script line above the heading, tilted -2deg on the Follow card, and the 404 page has a script "404" above its title. It is decoration the build carries, not a pattern for new sections. The Menu and Visit headings no longer have one.

Duplicate adjacent links. The Follow card's phone number and its Call-now pill link to the same `tel:` address, and the Visit map tile and its "Get directions" button link to the same map URL under the same accessible name, so each pair is two tab stops for one action.

An About glow that never paints. The About backdrop glow is `z-index: -1` with no stacking context around it, so it paints in the root stacking context behind the opaque body background: at 1440px wide not one pixel in its box changes with or without it. The hero's glow works because its section isolates.
White arrow on orange. On hover the hero scroll knob's ink disc turns orange while its arrow stays white (2.9:1; an icon on a desktop-only control).

Token drift. The ten-step spacing scale (`--s-1` to `--s-10`) is consumed by no stylesheet, and `--r-sm` is unused (the details button hard-codes 0.5rem). The orange gradient is written out seven times (button, tab pill, About play button, Follow call pill, quick-view call pill, phone-menu call pill, dock Call) instead of being a token, and the button component's soft and large variants have no call sites.

Motion rule drift. The repo's rule exempts only the Follow card's width and radius from "opacity and transform only", but the tab pill's slide also tweens `width` (a FLIP-style move) and the phone menu's circular reveal drives `clip-path` through a custom property. Both are recorded as built.
